name: Pull Request
about: Submit code changes, bug fixes, or localisation updates to the FPA.

### Description
Please provide a clear and concise summary of the changes introduced by this pull request. Explain the problem being solved or the feature being added.

### Related Issues
Fixes #[Insert issue number here, e.g. #42]

### Type of Change
Please delete options that are not relevant:
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Localisation / Translation update
- [ ] Code refactoring or cleanup

### Testing Environment
- **Joomla! Version tested:**
- **PHP Version tested:** (Must be PHP 7.4 or higher)
- **Database Version tested:**

### Checklist
Before submitting this pull request, please confirm the following:
- [ ] My code targets the `v2-dev` branch (not `main`).
- [ ] I have tested my changes against the minimum required environment (PHP 7.4+).
- [ ] If my changes modify, add, or delete user-facing text strings, I have updated the corresponding files in the `/lang/` folder (or notified the localisation team).
- [ ] My code follows the project's formatting standards and contains no trailing whitespaces.
- [ ] I have verified that no sensitive server configuration data or credentials are included in this commit.
